Update multiple internal or built-in objects from a YAML file.

The file should contain a YAML array of update items:
  - id: KSYN-001
    updates:
      priority: 10
  - id: COMP-TYPE-001
    updates:
      title: "Updated Title"

  Update multiple internal objects from file
  zqk internal bulk update --file updates.yaml
  Dry-run to see what would be updated
  zqk internal bulk update --file updates.yaml --dry-run

Usage:
  zqk internal bulk update --file <file> [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --dry-run                 Show what would be updated without actually updating
      --file string             Path to YAML file containing array of updates (required)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
